label: the generated entry stops being excluded from the served tree (the per-publish hash salt is downloadable, so the visitor hash stops being irreversible)
the counter stops being failure-soft (a throwing writeDataPoint surfaces as a rejected waitUntil the visitor paid for)
the bot filter never fires (crawler traffic is stored and billed, and lands in the pageview numbers)
the salt stops rotating daily (the visitor hash becomes a permanent cross-day identifier — the property the no-cookie claim rests on)
every response is counted, not just a delivered page (404 path-scanning bots become pageviews)
a same-site referrer is reported as a referrer (the site's own pages bury its real acquisition sources)
